txt:
Quarterly Numbers
The quarter closed with revenue up and costs flat. The table below carries the whole story; the paragraph after it carries the one caveat worth reading before quoting any of these figures to a board.
| Region | Revenue | Growth | 
|---|---|---|
| EMEA | 1200 | 4% | 
| APAC | 900 | 11% | 
| Americas | 2100 | 2% | 
Figures are unaudited and exclude the divested unit, which was consolidated for half of the period. The comparable basis is described in note seven of the full report.
